title: GoalSpec
description: Machine-readable definition of success for dynamic goal achievement. Replaces 'keep working until you are done' with deterministic criteria the flow engine evaluates. Owner apps/chat (embedded in WorkflowSpec.goal or supplied as a FlowRunRequest input). Criteria values are compared by the engine; an LLM evaluator may propose but never asserts a criterion as met.

required_outputs.description: Names of outputs / artifact roles that must exist before the goal can be complete (e.g. analysis_report, trained_model).

human_review_required.description: When true the loop exits with needs_human even if all criteria pass — the completion itself is a human decision (regulated Blueprints set this by default).

classification_max.description: Highest classification the goal run may touch; inherited from the Project when absent.

Criterion.description: metric is a key in the evaluator's metrics object (or `output.<name>` for required outputs). Deterministic comparison only.

weight.description: Contribution to the aggregate score (all criteria must still pass for complete).
